typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{TRADE KEYWORD LEI CP} as string,
		Trader as string,
		{TRADE KEYWORD OP CLRELG LCHUK DESC} as string,
		Comments as string,
		{TRADE KEYWORD OP ISDA Product Type} as string,
		{TRADE KEYWORD End User Clearing Exception Election} as string,
		{Trade Id} as string,
		{TRADE KEYWORD OP CLRELG CME DESC} as string,
		{CounterParty Full Name} as string,
		FileDate as date,
		{Sales Person} as string,
		{TRADE KEYWORD OP Clearing Eligibility} as string,
		Book as string,
		{Product Type} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		TRADE_KEYWORD_LEI_CP as string,
		Trader as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_CLRELG_LCHUK_DESC as string,
		Comments as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_ISDA_Product_Type as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_End_User_Clearing_Exception_Election as string,
		Trade_Id as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_CLRELG_CME_DESC as string,
		CounterParty_Full_Name as string,
		FileDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Sales_Person as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_Clearing_Eligibility as string,
		Book as string,
		Product_Type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TRADE_KEYWORD_LEI_CP = {TRADE KEYWORD LEI CP},
		Trader,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_CLRELG_LCHUK_DESC = {TRADE KEYWORD OP CLRELG LCHUK DESC},
		Comments,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_ISDA_Product_Type = {TRADE KEYWORD OP ISDA Product Type},
		TRADE_KEYWORD_End_User_Clearing_Exception_Election = {TRADE KEYWORD End User Clearing Exception Election},
		Trade_Id = {Trade Id},
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_CLRELG_CME_DESC = {TRADE KEYWORD OP CLRELG CME DESC},
		CounterParty_Full_Name = {CounterParty Full Name},
		FileDate,
		Sales_Person = {Sales Person},
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_Clearing_Eligibility = {TRADE KEYWORD OP Clearing Eligibility},
		Book,
		Product_Type = {Product Type})) ~> FlatFileDestination
